programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad der vil ske, var ikke
programme.desc: Der er opdaget tunneller på Seefra, som kan bruges til at nå otte andre Seefra-planeter.
programme.sub-title: Hvad der vil ske, var ikke

programme.title: Andromeda: Prøven
programme.desc: Da en gammel mand bliver dræbt, er Beka, Rhade og Harper de hovedmistænkte og skal for retten.

programme.title: Andromeda: Gennem et mørkt glas
programme.desc: Rhade leder oprørerne i en kamp mod en krigsherre på Seefra-5.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stolthed før faldet
programme.desc: Dylan finder ud af, at Bekas kæreste var Drago Musevini, og at han brugte Bekas DNA til at skabe nietzscheanerne.

programme.title: Andromeda: Måneskin bliver til dig
programme.desc: Beka og Rhade finder en prøve, der enten vil give dem stor rigdom eller drive dem til vanvid.

programme.title: Andromeda: Fortiden er uendelig
programme.desc: Harper opdager et program, der kan ødelægge otte af Seefra-planeterne og dræbe millioner af mennesker.

programme.title: Andromeda: Modsætningerne af tiltrækning
programme.desc: Mens Harper arbejder på en måde at redde Seefra-systemet på, sniger en spion sig om bord på Andromeda og angriber Beka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saving Light From a Black Sun
programme.desc: Der gøres et forsøg på at reparere Seefras blinkende sol, men Trance erstattes af en dobbeltgænger.
programme.sub-title: Saving Light From a Black Sun

programme.title: Andromeda: Samlet tilbagekaldelse
programme.desc: Da Dylan bliver alvorligt såret i en laboratorieeksplosion, rejser han gennem en række alternative virkeligheder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Quantum Tractate Delirium
programme.desc: Rommie bliver genopbygget for at hjælpe med at evakuere Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endnu en dags lys
programme.desc: En krigsherre overbeviser sine tilhængere om, at den forestående ødelæggelse af de ydre planeter er et komplot, der skal gøre det lettere for dem at plyndre deres planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos og stilheden i det
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade og Beka arbejder sammen for at redde Trance fra Methus-2 og Harper fra general Burma.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rejsens hjerte (del 1)
programme.desc: Besætningen når endelig ud af Seefra-systemet og opdager, at Dylan er den sidste Paradine

programme.title: Andromeda: Rejsens hjerte (del 2)
programme.desc: Den endelige kamp for at redde det nye systemers Commonwealth begynder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Under the Night
programme.desc: Efter at være strandet nær et sort hul bliver kaptajn Dylan Hunt opdaget af et bjærgningsskib og finder ud af, at han har været frosset i tiden i 300 år.

programme.title: Andromeda: En bekræftende flamme
programme.desc: Dylan beskytter Andromeda mod lejesoldater, mens Beka begynder at spekulere på, om de kæmper for den forkerte side.

programme.title: Andromeda: At miste det skæbnesvangre lyn
programme.desc: Dylan finder en rumstation fuld af børn, som tror, at han er der for at skabe fred ved at dræbe deres fjender.

programme.title: Andromeda: D Minus Zero
programme.desc: Andromeda-besætningen er stadig ved at lære at arbejde sammen, da de bliver angrebet af Restorers.

programme.title: Andromeda: Double Helix
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver involveret i en fejde mellem en Than-planet og en nietzscheansk koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon
programme.desc: En slipstream sender Andromeda tilbage i tiden til lige før Commonwealths fald. Besætningen må gribe ind for at bevare historien.
programme.sub-title: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon

programme.title: Andromeda: Båndene der blinder
programme.desc: Besætningen besvarer et nødopkald og samler Beckas bror, som nu er Wayist, og hans ven op.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: When a popular disc jockey was found murdered in a community garden, police swung into action. A sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, who had been much closer than they realized.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday School Ambush
programme.desc: When a man is gunned down in his own garage, investigators use science to unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Penchant for Poison
programme.desc: Three seemingly unrelated deaths prove to be serial murders. The killer had been careful; he used poison which had no taste or odor. Fortunately for investigators, it also had a unique chemical signature.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bump in the Night
programme.desc: When a victim is brutally murdered in his own bed, investigators find a shoe impression in the mud outside — physical evidence they hope will lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sole Searching
programme.desc: Armed with little else, police hoped that shoe impressions found at a Lansing, Michigan crime scene would put their investigation of Audrey Nichols' murder back on track.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder on the Menu
programme.desc: When the head chef of a historic Philadelphia restaurant was found dead, investigators interviewed the usual suspects: family, friends and coworkers. As they sifted through the evidence, police uncovered a chilling tale of debt and deceit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hot on the Trail
programme.desc: When Washington, DC is plagued by a series of arson fires — each started with the same type of incendiary device — it's up to forensic scientists to find the clues that lay in the ashes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: High 'n Dry
programme.desc: When Genell Plude is found dead in her bathroom, the scene points to suicide. But a coroner's inquest and a unique application of forensic science give investigators a different explanation for her death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: To the Viktor
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wired for Disaster
programme.desc: Faced with three homicides that appear to be professional executions, investigators on both sides of the Atlantic must find a common thread between the victims.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wood-be Killer
programme.desc: A killer tries to incinerate everything that could link him to his crime. But in doing so, he inadvertently creates new forensic evidence. Detectives employ a technique never before used in a criminal investigation to bring it to light.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Naughty or Nyce
programme.desc: A woman appears to have lost control of her SUV and plunged down an embankment into a shallow creek. But investigators suspect foul play when they find snowy footprints leading away from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Going for Broke
programme.desc: When a successful stockbroker doesn't return home after a late shift, his wife reports him missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Just Desserts
programme.desc: The prime suspect had a criminal record and his driver's license was found at the scene of a brutal double homicide.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sunday's Wake
programme.desc: When a little girl got sick and died, investigators were stumped. Was it an accident, an unexplained illness or murder?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shattered Dreams
programme.desc: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dockter Visit
programme.desc: An investigation into the murder of a World War II veteran slowed to a halt when the prime suspect had a solid alibi. But a lucky break led to a shady character who wore distinctive boots and had a sweet tooth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: A woman who was known to have suffered from depression apparently took her own life. But her sister told police that, a year before her death, she said if anything were to happen to her there would be a note in the china cabinet.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Concrete Alibi
programme.desc: An aspiring model turned up dead and the prime suspect was her boyfriend. When he was eventually cleared, investigators had to dig deeper to find the perpetrator. With the help of a forensic geologist, they identified the most unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Key Evidence
programme.desc: When an off-duty policeman was shot dead, his fellow officers were determined to solve the crime. They needed clues to find the killer and they discovered them in tiny fibres and an asthma inhaler.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: For serial killers, once is never enough. For investigators, the challenge is steep when the killers murder by numbers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Federal Offense
programme.desc: When there's a difficult case to crack  whether it involves drugs, arson, or weapons  the investigators and scientists of the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms have the means to crack it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Exploring the rugged Paringa River mouth and jet boating the Hall in remote South Westland.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A relaxing morning of whitebaiting with Sid—classic Kiwi tradition meets underwater spectacle.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Fishing soft baits and exploring scenic fishing spots around the Cavalli Islands.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A soft bait masterclass in the Bay of Islands, diving for scallops and a young fisher’s first spear catch.

programme.title: Carp Wars: Episode 19
programme.desc: Carp Wars is the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.title: Carp Wars: Episode 20
programme.desc: Carp Warsis the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.desc: Carp Warsis the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.desc: Carp Warsis the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.title: Carp Wars: Episode 23
programme.desc: Carp Warsis the ultimate head-to-head carp fishing competition, featuring five of the best and well-known carp fishing personalities in the UK.

programme.title: IFISH: Australian Salmon - Port Lincoln, SA
programme.desc: Local knowledge is always best, so when young Archie from Port Lincoln told me we were gonna smash some BIG Australian Salmon off the beach - I knew I was in for one hell of a day!

programme.title: IFISH: Spanish Mackerel - Namotu Island, Fiji
programme.desc: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

programme.title: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
programme.desc: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

programme.title: IFISH: Sailfish - Darwin, NT
programme.desc: When Paul hears the word "Darwin", two things come to mind - Barra and Crocs! So when PW got invited to fish for sailfish, in 20m of water, he couldn't say no! Get out your note pad and pen, because you're about to learn how you can do it all yourself!

programme.title: IFISH: Barramundi, Horizontal Falls, WA
programme.desc: There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it! Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programme.title: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programme.desc: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1
programme.desc: Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 2
programme.desc: Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 4
programme.desc: The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

programme.desc: Heidi elsker at være single, men da hun ser Spencer sammen med andre piger bliver hun jaloux. Whitney beder om Laurens hjælp til modeugen i LA.

programme.desc: Med Spencer ude af billedet, gør Heidi et sidste forsøg på at blive gode venner med Lauren igen. Da Audrina begynder at tilbringe mere tid med Heidi og Justin, overvejer Lauren, om de bør blive ved med at bo sammen.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: Gammel kærlighed blusser op da Stephen Coletti dukker op i Laurens liv igen. Heidi prøver at sørge for, at Stephanie ikke kommer til Laurens housewarming.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren har svært ved at vælge side, da problemerne mellem Lo og Audrina eskalerer. Og Heidi tager et job, der vil tage hende til Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit føler Audrina sig lukket ude af Laurens venskab med Lo, og hun overvejer at flytte ud. Lauren gør et sidste forsøg på at blive god venner med Audrina, men måske er det for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Da sæson fire starter er situationen mellem Audrina og Lo anspændt. Lauren forsøger at gøre et godt indtryk på en ny fyr, og et besøg fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie bliver uvenner med sin bror og hans ven da Lauren møder Spencer på sin fødselsdag. Kelly Cutrone fyrer en fra People's Revolution og Whitney overtager stillingen. Laurens forhold til Doug udvikler sig lidt for hurtigt.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at skabe fred mellem Brody og Stephanie. Audrina vil få tingene til at fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke give slip på hende. Stephanie tvivler på sin nye kæreste, da han bryder sit løfte om at konfrontere Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøger at redde sit venskab med Lauren efter at have anklaget hende for at have kysset med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøger deres bedstemore, som er træt af, at de skændes.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney bliver tilbudt en chance for a score sit drømmejob NYC og håber at se Jay der. Lauren bliver nostalgisk, da hendes forældre sælger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie går til Spencer for at få hjælp med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer deres bekymrede familier og stikker af til Mexico for at blive gift. Whitney går efter drømmejobbet i New York City, og siger farvel til Lauren og sit liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi mødes og husker, hvorfor de plejede at være venner. Spencer og Heidi er lige blevet gift, da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin chokerer Audrina, da han tager hende med til Palm Springs til en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Da Heidi kommer uanmeldt til Laurens fødselsdagsfest, græder de to gamle venner over deres ødelagte venskab. Spencer kommer op at slås, da Cameron beskylder ham for at samle en bartender op.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flirtende opførsel får Heidi til at tage hjem til Colorado, hvor hun møder en gammel kæreste. Lauren skælder Stephanie ud for at have inviteret Heidi til festen. Spencer ender en lang stilhed med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Da Heidi overrasker Spencer på en natklub med bartenderen Stacie, forlanger hun, at de går i parterapi. Lauren risikerer sit rygte, da hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikplads hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at komme sig over Justin ved at gå efter Brody. Heidi slæber en modvillig Spencer med til parterapi. Da Stephanie kvajer sig hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med at fyre hende.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at glemme Justin ved at score Brody, da pigerne tager med på drengenes surf-tur til Hawaii. Heidis uskyldige ekskæreste kommer på besøg, og hun håber, at hans værdier vil smitte af på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Chers verden går op i limningen med den pludselige tilstedeværelse af to lækre fyre i hendes liv: en sexet, ny klassekammerat og hendes kedelige men søde eks-stedbror. Hun lærer nu, at når det handler om kærlighed, så ved hun ingenting.

programme.title: Traffic
programme.desc: A conservative judge is appointed by the President to spearhead America's escalating war against drugs, only to discover that his teenage daughter is an addict.

programme.title: Plus One
programme.desc: For at overleve sommerens mange bryllupper aftaler de mangeårige venner, singlerne Ben og Alice, at være hinandens ledsagere til alle de bryllupper, de er inviteret til. Filmen vandt publikumsprisen på Tribeca Film Festival.

programme.title: The Bachelor Weekend
programme.desc: En meget moderne brudgom går modvilligt med til at tage på polterabend med sine venner i det vestlige Irlands vildmark. Til deres rædsel får de selskab af brudens uberegnelige bror, en alfahan kaldet "Maskinen"...

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: I denne både morsomme og rørende historie reflekterer Sir over sine bedrifter og forsøger at forlige sine turbulente venskaber med dem, han har ansat, inden tæppet går for sidste gang.

programme.title: Forår, sommer, efterår, vinter ... og forår
programme.desc: I en flydende eremitbolig midt i den koreanske vildmark guider en gammel munk en dreng gennem livets faser. Da drengen konfronteres med begær og vold, sættes hans visdom på prøve. En poetisk fortælling om balance, livscyklus og menneskelig indsigt.

programme.title: The Fountain
programme.desc: Hugh Jackman og den Oscar® vindende Rachel Weiszspinder instruktøren Darren Aronofsky en tidløs fabel om en mands søgen efter Livets Træ.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Den hurtigtsnakkende Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) har udset sig Newage-guruen dr. Sinja. Men efter et mystisk Bodhi-træ dukker op i hans have, indser Jack, at han hellere må forbedre sig, før det sidste blad falder af træet, ellers er han færdig.

programme.title: Boys And Girls
programme.desc: Ryan (Freddie Prinze, Jr.) og Jennifer (Claire Forlani) kunne ikke være mere forskellige. Som børn hadede de hinanden. Som voksne binder deres forskelle dem sammen i denne sjove RomCom fra instruktøren bag SHE'S ALL THAT.

programme.title: Jumper
programme.desc: David Rice er en Jumper, dvs. født med evnen til at teleportere sig hen, hvor han vil. Han opdager, at andre har samme evne, og bliver pludselig jagtet af fanatikere, der har svoret at eliminere alle Jumpere. Måske er denne evne nu hans eneste chance.

programme.title: Take Shelter
programme.desc: Curtis lever stille i Ohio med sin kone Samantha og deres døve datter. Alt er roligt, indtil hans forudanelser om en frygtelig tornado gør ham besat af at beskytte sin familie.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Viggo Mortensen (Green Book) spiller en undercoveragent, der er steget i graderne hos Yakuza, og nu befinder sig midt i en krig mellem Yakuza, mafiaen og FBI. Bemærk denne film vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: American Yakuza 2: Back to Back
programme.desc: Efter at en tidligere politibetjent (Michael Rooker, Guardians of the Galaxy) bliver indblandet i en kamp mellem japanske gangstere og bøller, opdager han, at han er blevet fældet af en korrupt politibetjent. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Terror In Disguise
programme.desc: Banks use a variety of devices to discourage would-be robbers: security cameras, silent alarms, and exploding dye packs. But when an elusive bank robber targeted Seattle's banks, none of these precautions were effective.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Predator
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, Washington, D.C., became the murder capital of the nation. Few were left untouched by gang violence, which was ignited by the drug trade. By 1994, that violence would strike at the very heart of law enforcement.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dishonored
programme.desc: Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Business
programme.desc: Many escape the poverty of India to start new lives in the United States. One turned the American dream into a nightmare. People started turning up dead in New York's Indian community-authorities struggled to link fraud and murder to a powerful man.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Temple of Fear
programme.desc: In Miami, the discovery of a mutilated body sent investigators on the trail of a deadly cult. But agents found a wall of silence around the cult's members. Potential witnesses, terrified of reprisals, refused to talk.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Silent Strike
programme.desc: Money may not be the root of all evil, but for some men, a million dollars is enough to justify murder. Even men sworn to uphold the law can sometimes be tempted.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Manhunt
programme.desc: A killer was on the loose in one of America's most popular tourist destinations. Armed and desperate, he evaded law enforcement at every turn. As the Fourth of July weekend quickly approached, thousands of people became potential targets.

programme.title: The Kids Are All Right
programme.desc: the kids are all right Det lesbiske ægtepar Nic og Jules havde den perfekte familie. Men de får sig et chok, da husets to teenagebørn opsøger den sæddonor, der er deres biologiske far. En øko-hippie ved navn Paul. En ren feel-good komedie.

programme.title: Youth In Revolt
programme.desc: På en ferie møder den kiksede teenager Nick Twisp drømmepigen Sheeni. Nick, der ikke tidligere har haft held med piger, vil gøre alt for at vinde hendes hjerte og opfinder et alter-ego, den flamboyante og dristige Francois Dillinger.

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Den unge journalist Tama Drewe vender tilbage til sine rødder i en engelsk landsby, for at sælge sit barndomshjem efter sin mors død. Stort drama, på grænsen til tumult, udspiller sig, når nya og gamle bekendtskaber går på jagt efter den ægte kærlighed.

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Diane er en snerpet advokat fra New York, der netop er blevet vraget af sin mand. I et desperat forsøg på at glemme alt om skilsmissen, tager hun sammen med sine to teenagebørn på en impulsiv weekendtur. Destinationen er en økologisk gård nær Woodstock.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banana Joe er ellers sådan en fredelig fyr, men nu har han ikke noget andet valg end, på ægte 'Bud Spencer' manér, at smide mafiaen ud af landsbyen Amanlido, så der igen kan blive fredeligt at bo der!

programme.title: Horrible Histories: The Movie - Rotten Romans
programme.desc: Baseret på BBC’s komedieserie “Horrible Histories”. Den romerske teenager Atti tvinges til at slutte sig til den romerske hær, da en af hans smarte idéer bringer ham i unåde hos kejser Nero. Han sendes til det forfærdelige, kolde og våde Britannien...

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Da en hårdtarbejdende redaktør på The New Yorker (Helen Hunt) følger efter sin søn (Brenton Thwaites) til L.A., efter han er droppet ud af college for at finde sig selv, ender hun med selv at være den, der kastes ud i en fuldstændig forvandling.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad har en udmærket karriere og lever et komfortabelt liv sammen med sin hustru og søn, men hans gamle venners liv virker mere glamourøst og rigt. Da han genoptager kontakten med dem, kommer han dog til at tvivle på, hvem der lever det gode liv.

programme.title: Black Knight
programme.desc: Da en klog sort hustler fra South Central i Los Angeles bliver transporteret tilbage til middelalderens England, leder han omstyrtelsen af en ond konge og vinder en protofeministisk kvindes hjerte.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman (Seven, Red, Batman Begins) kendt men aldrende skuespiller møder på sin research til en ny rolle en smuk spansk kassedame, der er mere end træt af sit job, som består i at servicere de kunder som har 10 eller færre varer.

programme.title: COPS: Nothing Upstairs
programme.desc: Officers pursue a motorcyclist driving erratically. Deputies find broken drug paraphernalia in a car when conducting a traffic stop. A man who beat up his girlfriend hides from officers in an attic.

programme.title: COPS: Follow Me to the River
programme.desc: A deputy jumps into a waterway to arrest a fleeing suspect. Officers respond to roommates in an argument. Officers are called when two crossdressers attack a group of women.

programme.title: COPS: Hiding the Evidence
programme.desc: A drug dealer swallows something suspicious as deputies move in to arrest him. Deputies pull over a father with his son in the car. A woman files a kidnapping report against her own boyfriend.

programme.title: COPS: Blame my Man
programme.desc: A man runs from police claiming he heard a gunshot. A woman lays the blame on her boyfriend. Officers confront a man who refuses to come down from a roof.

programme.title: 21st Century Serial Killer: Jesse Matthew
programme.desc: A taxi driver in Charlottesville who targeted young woman at university campuses. DNA linked an unknown perpetrator to an abduction, rape and attempted murder in 2005, and a rape and murder in 2009.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: In Guilvinec in Finistère, the body of Marie-Michèle Calvez was discovered in the trunk of her burned car. This murder is a real criminal enigma. Who killed this 40-year-old woman loved by all?

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: On August 4, 1997, the body of Christian Jambert, a retired gendarme, was discovered in his house in Auxerre. A 22 long rifle was placed on his legs.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: In Fos-sur-Mer in the Bouches-du-Rhône, Nadine Chabert said goodbye for the last time to her daughter Émilie. No one would see this 33-year-old mother again.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: The body of Ghislaine Leclerc was discovered in her house in Volesvres in Saône et Loire. In an attempt to solve the murder of this 57-year-old woman, the police follow many leads.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: The firefighters of Annemasse in Haute-Savoie were alerted by an anonymous call of the presence of an injured man lying on a small road at the exit of the city.

programme.title: Unsolved Murders
programme.desc: In Saint-Malo, the body of a teenage girl was found below a cliff.
programme.sub-title: A Murder Disguised as a Suicide

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal. When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted. The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Surveillance video is often the most precise witness to a crime. After three brutal murders were caught on tape in Alabama, the suspects fled the area. They had an arsenal of stolen weapons, and swore they wouldn't be taken alive.

programme.title: South Park: Sjov med våben
programme.desc: Drengene køber kampsportsvåben på et loppemarked og forvandles til japanske tegnefilmskrigere. Det får hårde konsekvenser for stakkels Butters.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en anal sondeundersøgelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer, at han har et nærgående møde med et rumvæsen. De andre drenge er overbeviste om, at drømmen var virkelig, og at han har været offer for en anal sondeundersøgelse af et rumvæsen.

programme.title: Tosh.0: 629
programme.desc: I det her juleafsnit finder Daniel ud af, hvem der skød den sorte julemand, viser sin værste "jeg er bedre end dig, bæ i dit fjæs" og afslører en gammel familieopskrift.

programme.title: Workaholics: Gone Catfishing
programme.desc: Adam og Ders planlægger en 4/20-fest, men Blakes nye kæreste rakker ned på dem.

programme.title: Workaholics: Three and a Half Men
programme.desc: Drengene filmer en dokumentar om Karls operation.

programme.title: South Park: Homoseksualitetens røde skilt
programme.desc: Hele South Park møder op til den årlige genopførelse af et slag fra borgerkrigen.

programme.title: South Park: Tsst!
programme.desc: Da det går op for Cartmans mor, at hun ikke længere kan kontrollere sin søn, får hun hjælp fra en ekspert. Cesar Millan, 'Hundehviskeren' tager udfordringen op.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: True Hollywood Stories: Prince & Red Balls Energy Drink
programme.desc: Negrodamus answers questions, and Charlie Murphy plays basketball with Prince.
programme.sub-title: True Hollywood Stories: Prince & Red Balls Energy Drink

programme.title: South Park: Røvburgere
programme.desc: Stan's eksistentielle krise fortsætter, og Cartman går ind i burgerbranchen med en superhemmelig, helt særlig ingrediens.

programme.title: Workaholics: * Piss and S*t
programme.desc: Anders, Adam og Blake tænker kreativt, da de skal bestå en narkotest på jobbet. De forsøger at bestikke mindre børn for at få rene urinprøver.

programme.title: South Park: Mareridt på FaceTime
programme.desc: Randys planer for Halloween betyder, at Stan ikke kan lave slik og ballade med sine venner.

programme.title: South Park: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: Stans far bliver arresteret for spritkørsel. Samtidig tiltrækker en blødende madonnastatue i nabobyen alle mulige mislykkede eksistenser, som håber på helbredelse.

programme.title: South Park: Rektor PC's endelige retfærdighed
programme.desc: Kyle prioriterer en farlig alliance højere end sit venskab med Stan.

programme.title: South Park: 'Snuke'
programme.desc: Indbyggerne i South Park lader op til Hillary Clintons ankomst. Cartman har mistanke om, at en ny muslimsk elev er involveret i et muligt terrorangreb.

programme.title: South Park: En History Channel-thanksgiving

programme.title: South Park: Øjenbetændelse
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny bliver slået ihjel af en nedfaldende rumstation og bliver forvandlet til en zombie af noget balsamerende væske, der er forurenet med engelsk sovs.

programme.title: South Park: Fedskæg

programme.title: RENO 911!: Strong Sister
programme.desc: Strong Sister magazine visits the station for an in-depth profile on Williams, and the deputies enforce Reno's six-foot rule for lap dances.

programme.title: Workaholics: Office Campout
programme.desc: Anders, Adam og Blake overnatter på kontoret. De tager t-shirts på, der er lavet specielt på turen. Når de tager svampe, støder de på indbrudstyve, mens de tripper.

programme.title: South Park: Verdenskrig Zimmerman
programme.desc: Cartman anser Token for at være en trussel mod hele menneskeheden.

programme.title: South Park: Kongelig budding

programme.title: South Park: Her kommer kvarteret
programme.desc: Som det eneste rige barn i byen, føler Token sig som et udskud, og detlykkes ham at tiltrække adskillige andre velhavende folk til South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 1
programme.desc: Drengene befinder sig i et magisk land, hvor hele verdens fantasi ligger lige foran dem. Men en terrorplan truer med at ødelægge det hele.

programme.title: South Park: Grå daggry

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Doug Williams
programme.desc: Doug Williams diskuterer aktuelle emner som svineinfluenza, økonomien og hvorfor man ikke skal købe Viagra i ghettoen.

programme.title: South Park: Du Yelper ikke
programme.desc: Cartman mener, at han er den bedste online-restaurantanmelder i South Park.

programme.desc: Fyrene prøver at vinde en konkurrence på kontoret om at give blod for at møde deres idol Dolph Lundgren.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Make-A-Wish & Fisticuff

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover Drug Bust
programme.desc: Jones and Garcia enjoy their undercover stakeout a little too much, and Dangle and Clemmy start the department's first rock band.

programme.title: South Park: Førskole
programme.desc: Drengene kommer i store problemer, da en dreng, de angav for at sætte ild til en lærer, bliver løsladt fra ungdomsfængslet.

programme.title: Broad City: Twaining Day
programme.desc: Abbi vender tilbage til Soulstice, og det bliver interessant, da hun bliver tilbudt den træning, hun altid har drømt om. Ilana får et nyt job på en restaurant.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fire Fighters Are Jerks
programme.desc: The accursed Fire Department schedules its Pancake Dinner at the same time as the Policeman's Ball.

programme.title: South Park: D-Yikes!
programme.desc: Ms. Garrison beslutter, at blive lesbisk, efter at hun igen er blevet svigtet. Drengene hyrer mexikanske immigranter til at lave deres hjemmeopgaver.

programme.title: Corporate: The Importance of Talking S**t
programme.desc: Mens de ansatte hos Hampton DeVille sladrer og er passivt-aggressive i konflikterne, skaber de usandsynlige bånd og nye fjender.

programme.title: South Park: Problemet med en bæ
programme.desc: Mr. Hankeys stødende opførsel bringer ham i fare for at blive fyret som direktør for det årlige juleshow. Imens møder Stærk Kvinde og Rektor PK nogle helt nye udfordringer i deres forhold.

programme.title: Workaholics: High Art
programme.desc: Adam og Ders prøver at blive rige opfindere, mens Blake bliver medlem af en kunstgruppe for teenagere.

programme.title: Workaholics: Wolves of Rancho
programme.desc: Gutta bliver flyttet til en anden afdeling i TelAmeriCorp for at arbejde for en karismatisk leder.

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: PopCopy & Clayton Bigsby
programme.desc: A blind white supremacist unleashes hate, and Dave unveils Nat King Cole's booty videos.

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Cartman bliver lykkelig over at opdage, at han kan sige, hvad han vil til hvem han vil ved at forgive at have Tourettes. Det landsdækkende tv dukker naturligvis op.

programme.title: South Park: Lad dem spise klisterstads

programme.title: South Park: Pragtsvinet mod Danmark
programme.desc: Pragtsvinet vil ikke længere være præsident.

programme.title: South Park: Sexchikane-panda
programme.desc: Cartman sagsøger Stan for seksuel chikane.

programme.title: South Park: W.T.F.
programme.desc: Efter at have set deres første live WWE wrestling-kamp beslutter drengene at danne deres eget wrestlingforbund og får en stor fanskare af rednecks!

programme.title: South Park: Goobacks
programme.desc: South Park er invaderet af arbejdere fra fremtiden, som tager alle job for en lavere betaling. Mændene i South Park griber til usædvanlige midler for at standse dem.

programme.title: South Park: Tolerancens dødskamp
programme.desc: Mr. Garrison vender tilbage til lærergerningen for at erstatte Mr. Hat, og drengene bliver sendt til Tolerancens Dødskamp.

programme.title: South Park: En dreng og en præst
programme.desc: Et meget specielt forhold udvikler sig mellem Butters og den lokale præst. Da byens indbyggere kommer hen til en lukket kirke, og de to venner er forsvundet, tilkalder de den katolske kirke.

programme.title: South Park: Uopfyldt
programme.desc: South Park bliver valgt til at huse Amazons nyeste logistikcenter.

programme.title: South Park: Danser med smølfer
programme.desc: Cartmans får endelig et sted, hvor han kan komme af med sin galde, da han bliver udnævnt til oplæser på skolen, og han udnytter selvfølgelig situationen.

programme.title: South Park: Giv slip, regering
programme.desc: Cartman infiltrerer NSA for at afsløre dem og bliver ikke glad for at se, hvad han finder i sin egen mappe.

programme.title: South Park: Grå daggry
programme.desc: De ældre indbyggere bliver tvunget til at indlevere deres kørekort efter at have forårsaget kaos i gaderne. Stans bedstefar tilkalder AARP for at hjælpe pensionisterne.

programme.title: South Park: Fantasiland del 2
programme.desc: Regeringen holder Stan og Kyle i fangenskab og vil ikke frigive dem, før de afslører, hvordan de kom ind i Imaginationland.

programme.title: South Park: Obama vinder!
programme.desc: Eric Cartman gemmer noget på sit værelse, der kan ændre udfaldet af præsidentvalget.

programme.title: South Park: Mit fremtidige mig
programme.desc: En 32-årig mand ankommer til South Park og påstår, at han er Stan fra fremtiden, og Cartman går ind i hævnbranchen.

programme.title: South Park: Verdensomspændende blokfløjtekoncert
programme.desc: Klassen skal opføre en blokfløjtekoncert i Mr. Garrisons hjemby i Arkansas, hvor de forsøger at finde 'den brune lyd'.

programme.title: South Park: Du Yelper ikke
programme.desc: Cartman mener, at han er den bedste online-restaurantanmelder i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Hummel-figurer & heroin
programme.desc: Elskede entertainere dør i deres bedste levetid på grund af overdoser. Stan er ved at blive afsløret som kilden til de ulovlige stoffer.

programme.title: South Park: Gratis hat
programme.desc: Drengene tager en sag til sig, da de indser, at deres yndlingsfilm bliver forbedret, genudgivet og ødelagt i processen.

programme.title: South Park: Forkrøblet sommer

programme.title: South Park: Kun for medlemmer
programme.desc: Den nyvalgte præsident besøger sin hjemby.

programme.title: South Park: Læg den væk

programme.title: South Park: Kinaproblemer

programme.title: South Park: Børnekidnapning er ikke sjovt
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at beskytte deres børn fra kidnappere, hyrer forældrene ejeren af City Wok for at bygge den Kinesiske Mur i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Tilbage til rødderne
programme.desc: Butters begynder en rejse, der skal følge i sporene på hans hawaiianske forfædre.

programme.title: South Park: Mr. Hankey, julebæen
programme.desc: Borgmesteren beslutter at indføre et neutralt helligdagstema, som ikke kan fornærme nogen. Kyle mener, at han har svaret.

programme.title: South Park: Kenny dør

programme.title: South Park: Chef går bananas
programme.desc: Chef erklærer, at South Parks flag er racistisk. Stan og Kyle leder den gruppe, der støtter det nuværende flag, mens Wendy og Cartman slutter sig til dem, som går ind for et nyt flag.

programme.title: South Park: Scooterne
programme.desc: Børnene vil bruge det seneste i transportmidler for at få mere slik til Halloween end nogensinde før.

programme.desc: Da drengene prøver at lære alt om Thanksgiving ved at se History Channel, bliver de rodet ind i et mysterium der involverer aliens, Natalie Portman og indmad!

programme.desc: Traveling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

programme.desc: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher. Meanwhile, Sokka gets himself in a jam.

programme.desc: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Uncle and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Serpent's Pass
programme.desc: The group then huddles around the map to discuss in which direction they should go - the Serpent's Pass appears to be the most direct route.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
programme.desc: Aang discovers a secret Fire Nation super weapon heading straight for Ba Sing Se and must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them. Meanwhile, Jet tries to find proof that Zuko and Uncle are Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Tales of Ba Sing Se
programme.desc: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Uncle, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

programme.desc: In this special episode, we go back in time to the moment Appa was stolen, and find out exactly what happened to him, and where's he's been all this time - and where he is now!

programme.desc: While searching for Appa, the kids run into Jet, but are torn about whether to trust him or not. Meanwhile, Zuko also hunts for Appa.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Awakening
